s.note: the Autobots tiptoeing around the Witwicky backyard
s.how: Roll 500g beef mince into 8 balls and smash thin on a very hot grill. Season, flip after a minute and melt cheddar on top. Tuck into slider buns with a pickle slice and a squeeze of tomato sauce and pile onto a tray.

Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp and golden, then salt well. Melt 150g grated cheddar into 125g cream cheese with a splash of milk and chopped jalapenos until smooth. Serve the chips with the warm dip.

m.note: Sam's dad Ron and his precious lawn
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with smoked paprika, brown sugar and salt. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 3 hours. Brush with barbecue sauce and char over hot coals. Serve with a coleslaw of shredded cabbage and grated carrot in a light mayo dressing.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes and cool completely. Cut into neat cubes and dust with edible glitter so they shimmer like the cube.

d.how: Fill glasses with crushed ice. Pour in cold lemonade and add a drop of blue food colouring, stirring until bright blue. Squeeze in a wedge of lime and serve straight away, glowing like fuel for giant robots.
